examples.summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones and TAB-002 for thread terminations. Grinding relief grooves are sized by shaft diameter (18mm to >125mm) with specific widths, depths, radii, and 30° angles to provide grinding wheel clearance. Thread relief grooves are sized by thread pitch (P≤1.25 to 2.5≤P≤3) and are required where threads end at shoulders. All dimensions include specific tolerances and must be compared against UNI4386 standard, with TRASMITAL specifications shown as solid lines versus UNI regulation dashed lines.

Specific tolerances apply to each diameter range, and grooves must be detailed on drawings.
